history.headline: The open engine for AI-powered search and observability
history.subheadline: Index once, then search, retrieve, and analyze across everything you build and run. OpenSearch is open source that stays open: vendor-neutral, fully Apache 2.0 licensed from ingest to dashboard, and a project of the Linux Foundation.
